items.text: Hi Scouts!
We've made a small break in the development of our upcoming game (You're Nuts!) to polish some behaviors and quests that our community made us aware of.
Even though we are not adding extra content, we wish these tweaks bring you a better feeling while playing Oppidum.
Polished rare cases where you could cross walls when you are knocked down to the ground
Polished Beach Pong quest and NPC dialogues
the quest is now completed after defeating the third NPC
you can still play against the fourth NPC, but it's no longer part of the quest
some dialogues have been changed or added to fit these changes

What isn't changing: each NPC's difficulty level, and the reward (which you get at the start of the quest in this case, not at the end). We want the fight itself to stay a real challenge for anyone who wants to take it on.

We are always looking for interactions with our community and we always read your feedback. We also make everything in our power to polish the game, and really appreciate the sweet words we receive in our Discord community or in the reviews.
As devs and gamers, we love this game and developed it with our best intentions, so reading words like our last reviews, really made our days :) Here are some of the last we received:
"I’m so glad I got the game. I’m having a lot of fun with it. I can’t believe it’s not more popular." - W4RH4MMERS

"Hola soy mexicano gracias por darme el mejor juego de mi vida !! Si algun dia termina y cierran los servidores porfavor haganlo offline para jugar por siempre, gracias por tantas horas de juego!!! ❤️🫰🏽🫶🏽" - Destoor
The more popular the game becomes, the more we will be able to do for it. So, as always, thank you for your support <3
The EP Games Team
Scouts, new polishing has been deployed to the island! ːscoutcompassː
Even though this time we are not adding extra content, we believe these improvements will bring you a better feeling while playing Oppidum. Have a look at the following patch notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/bab2ac6e0462d849268a25aef11536d6426ab780.png"]
New arcade control for your mount, more similar to how the character is controlled. It's activated by default and can be disabled in order to use the old control.
Small balance tweaks to adjust difficulty
Fix: Attack speed buff on gloves/gauntlets was not working properly

By the way, it's also some time for celebration! Not only did Oppidum win the Best Accessibility Award last November in Iris Games Awards, but also won the Best Adventure Game award in DeVuego Awards 2025 some days ago.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/d2086f68b34ae9a8682c37332b2e63099efeb520.png"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/ca5e2af26e8e8a1ddf265e0a13fe29f57b00a4d2.png"]
Finally, a special shout-out to our community member, dehteh, who has created an amazing tool: an interactive map of Insule! https://oppidum.fandom.com/wiki/Map:Insule
For now, it includes: major locations, Fast Travel/Respawn Totems, Trader Locations, Chest Locations, Thudulk Camps, Dora Spawn Points and Relic Locations. ːkingmarkː
That would be all for today! As always, let us know what you think. We are always looking for interactions with our lovely community ːtamaiː Your feedback matters. ːtamaiː
The EP Games Team

releases.displayName: Huge content update for Oppidum is now ready!

items.text: Insule has a lot more to offer to you now. Either if you're a returning adventurer or your adventure is about to start, you'll want to know about all that's new in Oppidum: ːtamaiː
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/9a8f8a0cad535e3b9e227be92ebf9d4a2048f82e.png"]
Beach Pong. You can play versus some bennies or versus a friend.
Battle Arena. You can fight waves of enemies (1 to 4 players) and get rewards. You can also challenge your friend(s) (PvP!! 2-4 players).
Traveller and Portal Scrolls will now be considered "Consumables" instead of "Valuables", so you can stack many of them in a single inventory slot.
You can now see the Credits from the Main Menu: can you bet how many devs made this game before watching it?

Default Resources Multiplicator has been changed from 1x to 1.4x for Default, Smooth and Relaxed game settings. This will reflect more precisely what you have told us about what you expect from the game!

New pause feature (thx @Dragonsblade!). This is a new mappeable button (which is mapped to P in keyboard, but unmapped in gamepad by default) and you can find it in "Controls" settings. This new feature also works in multiplayer (it will pause the game for everyone, and anyone can unpause after a few seconds).

You can now break any item into Tamai in the Tamai Enchantment Desk, including weapons and armors. For any item with durability, the resulting Tamai will be 50% less if the durability bar is empty, and proportional between 0 and 100%.
New "Snap to Grid" option when building. This will snap new buildings to 90º rotations and to positions, allowing to snap both to the grid and an adjacent building.
Now enemies stunned with a Perfect Parry will receive 30% bonus damage.
The attack bar over enemies doing a melee attack will turn orange in the point where you should do a parry in order to stun them.
At EP Games we've got a quite small tiny team, but we love listening to our community, being in touch, solving doubts or fixing issues, and giving support to all of our games.
Share your gameplay videos on your socials and tag us @PlayOppidum or use #Oppidum!
Hope you love this update as much as we loved developing it for you, Scout ːtamaiː

releases.displayName: New patch with a new camera feature when using a controller

items.text: Hi Scout! Welcome back!
Have a look at the following patch notes and jump back into action. The world of Insule is expecting you.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/e5524b12bf59acde981f99302cb7706051376aa0.png"]
Now the camera will automatically rotate to face your movement when you move using a gamepad. There is a new option in Camera Settings to disable this behavior.

Improved the animation when your character looks at the Sun. This feature wasn't available on PS4 and Xbox One for performance reasons in the detection of the occlusion of the Sun, but we've optimized it and now it's available in all platforms.
Minor bug fixes

At EP Games we take very seriously our commitment towards our community and we love hearing back from you, so let us know what you think. Also, if you need help, don't hesitate to contact us: always available through support@epgames.gg or in our Discord server for a more immediate communication.
The EP Games Team
How is summer treating you, Scouts? ːscoutcompassː
At EP Games, we continue our job of supporting Oppidum with fixes and improvements to bring you the best possible experience.
The community on our Official Discord has kept growing and we are now more than 1000 members!
If you haven't joined us yet, we are waiting for you!

Even though we are quite a small tiny team, we are always in touch with the community, listening to your feedback and reports (if you've got any issue we are not aware of, please let us know, we want to help), and so we bring you today the last Patch Notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301819/1a30d7a6d96143472bb8dd27097ca238a583679f.png"]
Tasks achievement will progress for everyone in the party when one task is completed, instead of progressing only for the player who completes it

Fishing difficulty has been linked to the Health Behavior setting, so if Health Behavior is “No Damage Taken” or “Lots of HP Regen.”, it will be much easier; if it’s “Some HP regen.” (default), it will be a little bit easier; and the previous (original) difficulty will be linked to “No HP regen.”
Arcshine will not have a rain bonus to appear and the previous rain bonus will be applied always instead
Fixed ghost item in the Bank with certain swaps (thx @HaycheGee)
Fixed horses able to be called during a Boss battle (thx @DAS_leo)
ːtamaiː Let us know what you think about this patch! We're eager to read your feedback ːtamaiː
See you in Insule!
The EP Games Team
Hey hey, Scouts!
A bit over a month has passed by since the release of Oppidum, and players feedback is being great! ːsteamhappyː
Also, some community members have managed to get up and running a subreddit for the game. Ain't it cool? It's r/OppidumGame. Thank you, u/logginlogan, for the effort and enthusiasm <3

Meanwhile, we've been helping the community get going on our Official Discord, for example, creating some voice channels so you can match with other players and enjoy some runs together. At the moment, we are somewhat around 950 members, and it would be awesome to reach to 1000 to enter Server Discovery feature! If you haven't joined us yet, we are waiting for you!

Finally, we've been working on all known issues to get them fixed asap (if you've got any issue we are not aware of, please let us know, we want to help), and so we bring you today the last Patch Notes:
Polished camera movement smoothness with pitch
Fixed black trees / rocks when gathering in a certain rare circumstance
Fixed Depth of field was enabled when using the Telescope even if it was disabled in Settings
Minor bug fixes
Hope your adventures keep going on and Insule gets the help it needs!
See you in Insule!
The EP Games Team

items.text: Hello Scouts!
Today we bring you some improvements for the Horses, as well as some minor fixes, hoping this way your rides around Insule are a bit smoother.
Horse will now gallop to your position when called instead of trotting
Horse will try to dodge obstacles better
Fixed horse falling through the woods on Dry-Dry Terraces
Minor bug fixes
As always, we are here to listen to your feedback and we'll keep working to bring you the smoothest possible experience!
See you in Insule!
The EP Games Team

topNew: Horse will now gallop to your position when called instead of trotting
Horse will try to dodge obstacles better

items.text: Here we come again with interesting news!
Some of the most common issues have been inventory space, fishing and doubts about certain items that were not clear how or where to obtain, so those are the things we tackled in this new patch.
Increased effect of “tired fish” when fishing: after 30 seconds of fishing, the fish starts moving slower and is easier to catch, this effect is what has been increased
Added an accessible mode for Fishing, linked to the “Single-Press Controls” Setting
Added two of the unlockable inventory slots to the beginning of the adventure, making the corresponding quests to unlock now just one slot instead of two upon their completion
New dialogue lines to explain better some very FAQs about items
Fixed a rare error related to lag that could lead to an item appearing duplicated in bank and inventory, but it wasn’t really there
We'll keep working to bring you the smoothest possible experience!
Your support is very much appreciated.
See you in Insule!
The EP Games Team
At EP Games we don't stop: thanks to the awesome community that you are growing, mostly on our Discord, we've detected and fixed some little issues.

We've been able to help you in between patches to fix some of the problems that we could immediately fix due to being an online game, but that's also thanks to you, scouts, who have been actively helping us understand what was troubling you and letting us access your game to help you continue with the adventure without further issues.

You've been playing for long hours and enjoying the adventure Insule has for you, either solo, with friends or even both! (we know you are making good use of the three slots available!), but there was an achievement you couldn't get just yet: get ready, download the new patch and jump into action!
Improved the video memory footprint
Added a Visual hint for Treasure Finder in compass so it does not depend exclusively on audio hint
Removing building or Moving building now allows to move / remove more buildings without need to enter the UI again until you cancel the action
Added a bit of range to allow the camera get closer to the player
Configurable zoom for gamepad (when using mouse, this can be changed anytime with the mouse wheel)
Added 2 missing chests that were necessary for the Sharp Explorer achievement
Fixed jump attack sticking the character between two enemies
Minor bug fixes
We appreciate your support and hope you can keep enjoying Oppidum!
See you in Insule!
The EP Games Team

topNew: Added a Visual hint for Treasure Finder in compass so it does not depend exclusively on audio hint
Added a bit of range to allow the camera get closer to the player

items.text: First days since release, what a ride! This is being a great adventure, guys.
You've been letting us know how much you love this game, but also some feedback for improvements.
We've been listening to the community, helping solve some tech-issues (mostly through our Discord) and working hard to bring you asap the first patch with some new features and improvements.
Unlimited usage of Teleport scrolls
Show distance in Compass
Vibrance
Brightness
Bloom (on/off)
Depth of Field (on/off)
Camera smoothing
New item: Sleeping Bag. Can be created in Workshop Level 1 and will allow you to sleep far from the Camp.
Hidden hotkey to disable UI (control + H)
Changed how Building Friendships quest is opened so it’s more understandable
Increased max pins in the map from 100 to 200
Changed the mapped keys in Animal Farm and Crops Farm to Rotate Left and Rotate Right instead of the UI map (by default they are the same keys, so this only affects if you want to remap the controls)
Minor bug fixes
We appreciate your support and hope you can keep enjoying Oppidum even more now.
See you in Insule!
The EP Games Team

releases.displayName: Incoming patch with new world settings

items.text: It's been just one day after release, but at EP Games we never stop! We are committed to our communities and our players, and so:

During the first hours, many people played the game for looooong sessions in all platforms (not only Steam, but also PlayStation and Xbox). We received beautiful feedback, as well as specific and helpful reports of small bugs that we fixed over the night (we are based in Europe). A little group reported crashes opening the game or on the first screen, but that was solved as well.
Well, we keep working on supporting our growing community, listening to players' feedback and fixing anything that arises.

Some of you got in touch with us to give feedback about how much travelling there's at the beginning, or how difficult it was for you to find some items. We developed Oppidum with a lot of options so each player could exactly enjoy it as they pleased. Because of that, in the following days we are adding:
Show distance in the compass markers
Unlimited use of Travelling Scrolls
These options won't be enabled by default, but you will be able to change them from World Settings so the game keeps adapting to your gameplay style.
Vibrance
Brightness
Bloom (on/off)
Depth of Field (on/off)
Hidden hotkey to disable UI (control + H)
See you in Insule (or Discord)
The EP Games Team

topNew: Show distance in the compass markers

items.text: Hey! We're releasing a patch for the Oppidum Demo that fixes a couple issues some of you were experiencing, as well as adding some nice improvements for a better experience. The servers will be under maintenance for a short while that shouldn't last more than a couple minutes!
You can now see your party members creating their character in real time during the character creation screen.
Dialogues with NPCs triggered by other players now appear marked by their favorite color to let you know you're not controlling the dialogue.
Fixed an issue where you couldn't move your camera with your mouse while in target mode, despite the existing setting that allowed it.
Fixed connection problems in certain circumstances.
Please, make sure to keep the Oppidum demo updated, and don't hesitate to contact us on the official Demo Feedback thread or on our Discord Server. Keep enjoying the demo!
—EP Games 🍃
